1. Open the app and select the vehicle that you want to inspect the brake of.
2. Click on the "Document Failed Brake Test" button.
3. Enter the date of the inspection in the "Date" popup.
4. Enter the test name in the "Test Name" popup.
5. Enter the "Pass" or "Fail" count in the respective popup.
6. Click on the "Save" button to save the updated record.
7. Verify the record in the app and make sure all the details are correct.
8. अगर浏览器を閉じるボタンをクリックすると、
9. The record should be saved successfully and you will be able to view the record in the inspection history.
